Question: Legal entity name
Expected format / validation: Free text (e.g. "Smith's HVAC LLC")

Question: Marketing name
Expected format / validation: Free text (e.g. "Smith's HVAC")

Question: Short name
Expected format / validation: Free text (e.g. "Smith's")

Question: Owner full name
Expected format / validation: Free text

Question: Year founded

Question: Production URL

Expected format / validation: Which leads the hero and the service ordering

Question: Main phone (E.164)
Expected format / validation: +1XXXXXXXXXX exactly

Expected format / validation: Same digits as E.164 - Step 0 validates this. Rendered EXACTLY as written everywhere; it is also the Google Ads number-swap match string

Question: SMS number (if different from main)
Expected format / validation: +1XXXXXXXXXX or blank if same as main

Question: Emergency / after-hours display
Expected format / validation: Display string, or "none". If none, EVERY 24-7 / emergency / after-hours phrase is removed in Step 6, including template surfaces

Question: Street address

Expected format / validation: Google Maps share link (the get-directions anchor; NOT the embedded map)

Expected format / validation: e.g. "NC General Contractor #12345". Look it up on the state board site. Leave blank if none - the block stays {} and no credential renders

Question: Insurance carrier / status
Expected format / validation: Backs any "Insured" claim - do not claim what this cannot confirm
Maps to: Content validation only - no config field

Question: Bonded?
Expected format / validation: Y/N with evidence
Maps to: Content validation only - no config field

Question: Certifications / manufacturer tiers
Expected format / validation: List each with HOW it was verified (e.g. CertainTeed Find a Pro, NATE lookup). Unverified = does not ship

Question: "Licensed"
Expected format / validation: Y/N. Requires the license row above

Question: "Insured" / "Bonded"
Expected format / validation: Y/N each. Requires the insurance and bonded rows above

Question: "Family-owned" / "family-run"
Expected format / validation: Y/N - owner-confirmed only

Question: "Locally owned"
Expected format / validation: Y/N - owner-confirmed only

Question: Customers / jobs served count
Expected format / validation: A number the owner will stand behind (e.g. "1000+"), or "do not claim"

Question: Emergency / 24-7 / same-day availability
Expected format / validation: What may be promised, exactly. "none" removes all such copy. A response-time promise is a claim, not tone

Question: Warranty / guarantee definition
Expected format / validation: What is covered, for how long, transferable or not. "Lifetime" must be defined before it is used

Question: Own crews vs subcontractors
Expected format / validation: Describe what the business DOES ("our own crews, start to finish"). Never an absolute ("never subcontracted")

Question: Trade association memberships
Expected format / validation: List with proof, or "none". If none the badge row is DELETED, not substituted

Question: BBB profile
Expected format / validation: URL + rating, or "none" (no profile = no BBB mention anywhere)

Question: Show a star rating / review count?
Expected format / validation: Y/N. With fewer than ~10 reviews the answer is normally N (named testimonials only). If Y, the exact count and where it renders

Question: Signature phrase
Expected format / validation: Owner's chosen tagline (e.g. "Same-Day Roofing") and what it may be attached to (repair yes, replacement no)

Question: Capabilities NOT offered
Expected format / validation: List anything a competitor site would show that this business does not do (insurance-claim filing, storm tarping, commercial membranes...). Prevents reference-site copy from adding them

Question: Trade name
Expected format / validation: e.g. "HVAC Service", "Roofing & Siding"

Expected format / validation: e.g. "NATE-Certified Technician". Must be a claim the Claims rows support

Question: Credential title (plural)
Expected format / validation: Stored separately - pluralization isn't always +s

Question: Industry association name
Expected format / validation: For badge alt text; blank if the Claims row says none

Question: Branded guarantee name
Expected format / validation: e.g. "Comfort Guarantee"

Expected format / validation: kebab-case (e.g. "hvac-service"). Default service dimension on non-service pages. PERMANENT once traffic exists; must not be derived from a display name

Question: Primary service display noun
Expected format / validation: e.g. "AC Repair"

Question: Two secondary services
Expected format / validation: Free text list

Question: Seasonal concern
Expected format / validation: e.g. "summer AC failures"

Question: Equipment term
Expected format / validation: e.g. "heat pump"

Question: Licensed descriptor

Expected format / validation: kebab-case {city}-{st} (e.g. faison-nc). City landings emit their own {city}-{st}. REQUIRED, PERMANENT

Expected format / validation: Comma-separated ZCTAs. We dissolve these into public/maps/{slug}-service-area.geojson for the Google Maps service-area map

Expected format / validation: Created by us in Cloud Console (referrer-restricted, Maps JavaScript API). Not a client question

Expected format / validation: RGB or hex - or blank and we derive L-5

Expected format / validation: RGB or hex. If it fails 4.5:1 on the background it is FILLS ONLY; we add a darker -secondary-text slot for type

Expected format / validation: RGB or hex - C2 pattern, root 4.5

Question: Body font
Expected format / validation: Google Font name + weights

Question: Launching with tracking?
Expected format / validation: Y/N

Expected format / validation: G-XXXXXXXXXX

Expected format / validation: Same format, or "none"

Expected format / validation: Which services appear in the form dropdown / cards (EBS omitted gutters and those leads arrived as "Other")

Question: Offer - title
Expected format / validation: Free text

Question: Offer - badge
Expected format / validation: e.g. "15% OFF" or "FREE"

Question: Offer - description
Expected format / validation: Free text

Question: Offer - minimum label
Expected format / validation: e.g. "($500 Minimum)" or blank

Expected format / validation: MM/DD/YYYY - a real rolling date, not a placeholder on an evergreen offer

Question: Founding story / about raw material

Expected format / validation: 4-6 steps in the owner's words. The template's default steps are LIVE copy on /contact and every service page until replaced

Question: Why choose us (3-4 reasons)
Expected format / validation: Short reason + one line each. Renders on every service page and city landing; defaults are live copy

Question: Stats to display
Expected format / validation: e.g. years, customers served, counties - each must match a Claims row

Question: Social profile URLs
Expected format / validation: Facebook/Instagram/LinkedIn/etc., or "none" (footer social row is removed). Google and Yelp are review profiles, not social

Question: Guarantee / warranty copy
Expected format / validation: Free text - must match the Claims warranty row

Question: Hero headline preferences
Expected format / validation: Free text or blank. Hero is a slide carousel; one headline per slide

Question: Destination address for submissions
Expected format / validation: Valid email the owner reads

Question: Sender domain choice
Expected format / validation: Client's own domain (needs DNS access for Resend verification) vs the template's sending domain. Free-mail cannot send

Question: BCC address
Expected format / validation: Valid email or blank

Expected format / validation: Full-colour on light AND a white/light version for dark grounds. Used in navbar, footer and the social card

Question: Favicon source mark
Expected format / validation: Square mark, high-res. We regenerate 192px public/favicon.png; check it on a dark browser tab

Expected format / validation: One per hero slide (EBS: 3). Landscape, real work by THIS client. Slide 1 is the LCP image and the social-card photo

Expected format / validation: File or "none" - the current hero is image slides; a video is a design change

Question: Per-city hero photo
Expected format / validation: One per city landing route. REQUIRED field with no default

Question: Gallery photos
Expected format / validation: 6-8 project photos with a caption each. Reuse across hero/gallery/service pages is allowed but dedupes silently

Question: Reviewer photos
Expected format / validation: Optional; if none, the review cards render initials. NEVER a previous client's avatars

Question: Before/after photos (if applicable)
Expected format / validation: File(s) or N/A

Expected format / validation: File(s) matching offers.items[*].couponPath, or blank (couponPath stays "")
